name: Plymouth and South West Devon Joint Local Plan
organisation-name: Plymouth City Council, South Hams District Council, West Devon Borough Council

housing-numbers.notes: Policy area includes Plymouth City Council administrative area plus urban fringe. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (2,705), under construction (901), and outstanding commitments (8,523). Also includes allowances for demolitions (-872) and student HMO releases (397).

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Thriving Towns and Villages Policy Area
housing-numbers.notes: Policy area covers rural South Hams and West Devon including market towns and villages. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (1,394), under construction (371), and outstanding commitments (3,337). Includes 550 homes allowance for Sustainable Villages.
